About Applica

A Lahore cosmetics house, built on everyday beauty

Applica Cosmetics (Private) Limited is a Lahore-based cosmetics company working across the full beauty shelf — colour cosmetics for the makeup bag, skincare for daily routines, hair care, fragrance and the personal-care essentials in between.

We serve customers directly and supply retailers, salons and resellers who need dependable quantities. Whatever the order size, the idea stays the same: well-chosen products, honest dealing, and a team that knows its range.
